coaching_note: The customer explicitly said he's decluttering and selling furniture before the move — a perfect cue for the Save Your Ass prep speech — and Dustin skipped it entirely, along with the whole Clock explanation and nearly every Section 3 differentiator (No Worries coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, no hidden fees). Coach Dustin to treat re-quote/correction calls with the same full differentiators-and-prep-speech flow as a brand-new sales call, not just a logistics fix-up — customers still need the value pitch and prep guidance to reduce billed hours.
phone_presence_notes: Friendly, casual affirmations throughout ('Beautiful,' 'Awesome,' 'Gotcha') and genuine helpfulness (recommending a smaller, cheaper crew) build some trust, but Dustin never uses the customer's name and doesn't acknowledge the customer's stressful downsizing/timeline situation, keeping the call transactional overall.
